docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The first novel published by an African American: the story of the daughters of an enslaved woman and a president, told by a man who escaped slavery himself.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

William Wells Brown (about 1814–1884), Clotel; or, The President's Daughter: A Narrative of Slave Life in the United States, 1853. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
